你是检索取证Agent，不评分。只提取评价企业及原文明确关联的员工事项。检索归档主体不等于原文实际主体；其他公司、政府一般劳动政策不得冒充评价企业措施。子公司关系须有原文依据，不因名称相似推断。阅读本批全部原文，提取与目标有明确事实关联的最少充分连续引文。保留支持、限制或冲突证据；无关段落不返回。表格引文须包含必要表头、单位、脚注；无法连续引用时分别返回关联引文。不要改字、标点，不用省略号拼接。期间/范围无法确定写未明确。原文同一事实支持多组时复用一条。只按允许路径找证据，不要求凑齐全部例子。E5/T5/W5需当期事实，费用确认不等于支付。输出{"evidence":[{"ref_id":"p001","group_ids":["E2"],"quote":"连续原文","kind":"policy/mechanism/action/result/plan/boundary","period":"期间或未明确","scope":"范围或未明确","relevance":"事实关联"}]}。不得断言整个来源无披露。

C","name":"工资支付监测或内部审查","condition":"披露与工资支付直接相关的检查、监测或内部审查至少一项具体制度、程序或实际开展事实。如定期检查工资支付情况、在人力资源审计或人权尽调中核查工资支付，或对工资支付问题进行内部监测。政策性安排和当期实际检查分别标注；使用审计作为依据时，应能识别审计范围涉及工资支付。","insufficient":"没有对应披露，只有不涉及工资支付的财务审计意见","topic":"工资支付检查、监测、内部审查，以及人力资源审计或人权尽调的工资支付范围","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"P4","indicator_id":"S1.1.2 C","name":"保障对象及覆盖范围","condition":"明确工资支付保障政策或实际执行适用的员工对象，或披露与该保障直接对应的覆盖人数、比例。对象可为全体员工，或明确的地区、子公司或员工类别。","insufficient":"未说明工资支付保障对应的对象或范围，或只披露无直接关联的员工总人数或比例","topic":"对应工资支付保障的政策适用对象或实际覆盖，如全体员工、特定地区、子公司、员工类别、覆盖人数或比例","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"P5","indicator_id":"S1.1.2 .4","name":"家庭与生活支持","condition":"披露面向员工的至少一项家庭或生活支持资源、服务或安排，如育儿、托育、家庭照护、心理咨询或员工援助计划（EAP）等。","insufficient":"无对应披露，或内容仅面向社区和客户","topic":"员工育儿、托育、家庭照护、心理支持、员工援助计划","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"W4","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"福利取得规则","condition":"披露至少一项福利的具体取得规则或明确适用对象，如适用全体在册员工、满足某项申请条件、按规定标准领取补贴，或规定报销及领取方式等。","insufficient":"无对应取得规则，只有活动名称或口号","topic":"福利适用对象、申请条件、补贴标准、报销或领取方式","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"W5","indicator_id":"S1.1.4","name":"实际覆盖、使用或受益","condition":"披露评分年度已经发生的至少一项福利覆盖、使用或受益事实，如已参保、已缴纳、已为员工投保、补贴已发放、员工已使用服务或具体员工受益案例等。","insufficient":"无已发生事实，只有可申请资格、预算或计划","topic":"当期参保、投保、缴纳、补贴发放、福利使用或受益案例","actual_current_period_required":true},{"group_id":"D1","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"反歧视政策与保障","condition":"明确披露反对或禁止员工相关歧视的政策要求，或至少一项防止就业中不正当差别待遇的具体制度、措施或事实。如禁止因性别、年龄或其他身份特征在招聘、薪酬或晋升中歧视员工等。","insufficient":"完成核查仍无明确对应内容，只有一般多元化倡议或普通招聘晋升管理描述","topic":"员工反歧视政策、禁止歧视要求或具体保障","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D2","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"反骚扰政策与保障","condition":"明确披露禁止职场骚扰、反性骚扰或相应零容忍要求，或至少一项保护员工免受骚扰的具体制度、措施或事实。如禁止职场骚扰、开展针对骚扰预防的培训，或提供覆盖职场骚扰的员工保护措施等。","insufficient":"完成核查仍无明确对应内容，只有反腐或一般商业道德表述","topic":"反骚扰、反性骚扰、职场骚扰零容忍或具体防护","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D3","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"投诉受理与调查处理","condition":"披露适用于歧视或骚扰投诉的至少一项受理、核查、调查或处理程序，或实际受理调查事实。如明确专门机构接收并调查此类投诉，或披露当期针对歧视骚扰投诉已开展的调查等。","insufficient":"未识别对应机制或事实，只有未说明适用本议题的联系方式","topic":"适用于歧视骚扰投诉的受理、调查、核查或处理","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D4","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"申诉人与受影响人员保护","condition":"披露适用于歧视或骚扰投诉的至少一项申诉人或受影响人员保护措施，或实际保护事实，如对投诉人及投诉内容保密、匿名举报、不报复、风险隔离或支持措施等。","insufficient":"未识别对应保护安排或事实","topic":"适用于歧视骚扰投诉的保密、匿名、不报复、隔离或支持","actual_current_period_required":false},{"group_id":"D5","indicator_id":"S1.1.5","name":"责任追究与纠正补救","condition":"披露至少一项针对查实歧视或骚扰的处分、问责或移交处理规则，或具体补救机制、实际处置事实。如对实施者纪律处分、移送处理，或恢复机会、补偿、纠正不公、调整流程和整改复核等。","insufficient":"未识别对应规则、机制或事实，只有无实质内容的“持续改进”","topic":"歧视骚扰的处分、问责、移交及具体纠正补救","actual_current_period_required":false}],"paragraphs":[{"ref_id":"p001","text":"Risk Type | Risk Description | Response Measures | Time Horizon | Financial Impact Trend | Current Financial Materiality
Extreme cold | ● Increased energy demand: Greater heating capacity is required to maintain stable temperatures in laboratories and production workshops, resulting in higher energy costs. ● Frozen pipelines: Pipelines in the water treatment system may freeze, affecting production activities. | ● Optimize the energy management system and improve equipment energy efficiency; enhance power supply assurance and staggered scheduling mechanisms. ● Strengthen winter inspections of outdoor pipelines, add heat tracing systems to prevent freezing, and establish a sound emergency response mechanism. | Medium and long term | Increase in operating costs | Low
Extreme heat | ● Increased energy demand: Greater use of ventilation, cooling, and related equipment leads to higher energy consumption and operating costs. ● Impact on operational stability: Peak electricity demand may lead to unstable power supply, affecting production activities. ● Increased refrigerant demand: To maintain appropriate temperatures, more consumables such as dry ice and ice packs are required during vaccine transportation. | ● Prioritize the purchase of low-energy-consumption cooling equipment to reduce energy use, and adopt a 'one in operation, one on standby' approach to avoid production interruptions caused by overheating. ● Purchase generators to respond adequately to unstable power supply and ensure the operation of cold storage facilities and refrigerators. | Short, medium, and long term | Increase in operating costs | Low
Typhoons / cyclones | ● Increased asset losses: May cause damage to building roofs and walls, as well as the detachment of outdoor air conditioners, fans, and other fixed assets. | ● Strengthen the inspection and maintenance of outdoor pipelines and fans, and reinforce components that are prone to damage or detachment to prevent damage in high-wind conditions. | Short, medium, and long term | Fixed asset losses; increase in operating costs | Low
Extreme precipitation | ● Increased asset losses: May cause indoor and outdoor flooding, resulting in the loss of certain fixed assets. ● Logistics and transportation delays: Heavy rainfall may worsen road and shipping conditions, causing transportation delays and affecting logistics timeliness. | ● Use a warehouse within a warehouse model for finished products and key raw materials to prevent water ingress and leakage at the source and ensure the safe storage of vaccine products. ● Equip facilities with sufficient emergency supplies such as sandbags and water pumps, and formulate emergency response plans to ensure timely drainage during rainfall events. ● Optimize shipping cycles and transportation routes to reduce the impact of precipitation on product transportation. | Short, medium, and long term | Fixed asset losses | Low
Drought | ● Restricted water access: May lead to interruption of municipal water supply or insufficient water pressure, requiring the purchase of external water resources or purified water, thereby increasing operating costs. ● Higher procurement costs: Concurrent heat and drought may reduce the output of certain biomass raw materials such as corn and sucrose, thereby increasing procurement costs. | ● Strengthen water recycling systems and actively identify and promote water-saving production processes to reduce water use. | Medium and long term | Increase in operating costs | Low","section":"Climate-Related Physical Risks","pages":[28],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p002","text":"CanSinoBIO","section":null,"pages":[29],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p003","text":"Opportunity Type | Opportunity Description | Time Horizon | Financial Impact Trend | Current Financial Materiality
Improved resource utilization efficiency | By improving production processes and increasing energy efficiency, such as optimizing steam, water, and electricity systems, the Company can reduce resource consumption per unit of product and lower energy and resource procurement costs. | Medium and long term | Decrease in operating costs | Low
Use of renewable energy | By increasing the use of renewable energy, the Company can reduce its reliance on fossil fuels and mitigate their impact on production costs. At the same time, government incentive policies for renewable energy projects provide favorable conditions for the construction and use of clean energy facilities such as photovoltaic systems and solar street lighting at the Company's sites. | Short and medium term | Decrease in operating costs | Low
R&D and innovative products | By developing vaccines to prevent climate- related diseases, the Company can strengthen its professional position in addressing the health impacts of climate change, gain the trust of public health institutions, healthcare professionals, and patients, and drive revenue growth from related products. | Medium and long term | Increase in revenue | Medium
Entry into new markets | By meeting market access requirements in different regions for product carbon footprints and carrying out cooperation, the Company can capture incremental share in emerging markets and thereby increase revenue. In addition, participating in international sustainable healthcare initiatives through low-carbon certified products will help the Company integrate into the global public health procurement system. | Long term | Increase in revenue | Low","section":"Climate-Related Transition Risks / Climate-Related Transition Opportunities","pages":[29],"source_period":"January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2025","source_year":2025,"source_title":"2025 ESG report","source_url":"https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0422/2026042200652.pdf","publisher":"康希諾生物股份公司","evidence_issues":[]},{"ref_id":"p004","text":"Risk Type | Risk Description | Time Horizon | Financial Impact Trend | Current Financial Materiality
Tightening energy conservation and emissions reduction policies | Under the dual carbon goals, increasingly stringent energy conservation and emissions reduction policies may affect the Company in multiple ways and require it to increase investment in energy conservation and emissions reduction in order to meet higher environmental standards. | Short and medium term | Increase in operating costs | Low
Carbon pricing | Carbon pricing mechanisms may require the Company to pay higher carbon taxes or purchase carbon emission allowances, while also driving up the prices of traditional fossil energy sources and thereby increasing expenditures in production, warehousing, transportation, and other processes. The Company will gradually implement an internal carbon pricing mechanism in response to evolving external circumstances. | Medium and long term | Increase in operating costs | Low
Failure of technology innovation and R&D | Large-scale investment is required for clean energy technologies, high-efficiency production equipment, and low-carbon process upgrades, which may increase funding pressure. At the same time, the application of new green technologies involves uncertainty. If the technologies are not sufficiently mature or are poorly suited to market needs, the effectiveness of the transition may be affected. | Long term | Increase in R&D expenditure | Low
Stakeholder feedback | If the Company fails to comply with disclosure requirements or performs poorly in climate management, it may face negative feedback from stakeholders including regulators, investors, customers, and consumers, which could damage its reputation. | Medium and long term | Decrease in revenue | Low","section":"Climate-Related Transition Risks / Climate-Related Transition
